plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, METU, MSFU, PLTU, MUU) to zero.
Trim QQQI to 20% to reduce concentration.
Hold broad index ETFs (SPY, QQQ) for stability.
Maintain a significant cash buffer for safety.
Focus on capital preservation with tight stops.
conservative.read: This plan prioritizes capital preservation, aiming for lower, steadier returns around 1.5% per month. It significantly reduces risk by cutting leveraged positions and holding more cash, which also limits upside potential.

plan: Trim leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, METU, MSFU, PLTU, MUU) to small positions.
Buy TECS as a hedge against tech weakness.
Maintain a balanced mix of broad index and quality tech.
Keep a moderate cash buffer of about 10%.
Focus on risk-first growth, aiming for around 2.5% per month.
balanced.read: This balanced approach aims for risk-first growth, targeting about 2.5% per month. It reduces leverage and concentration while adding a hedge, aiming for moderate gains with controlled drawdowns.

plan: Increase leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, METU, MSFU, PLTU, MUU) to 6% each.
Buy TECS at 6% to hedge against tech downturns.
Concentrate exposure in high-conviction leveraged plays.
Maintain a small cash buffer of about 5%.
Accept higher potential drawdowns for aggressive growth targeting ~4%/mo.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan aims for high growth, targeting around 4% per month, but comes with significantly higher risk and potential for large drawdowns. Leveraged ETFs decay daily, and concentration amplifies both gains and losses.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, METU, MSFU, PLTU, MUU) to zero.
Increase QQQI to 30% for income generation.
Hold broad index ETFs (SPY, QQQ) for stability.
Prioritize reliable monthly distributions over growth.
Aim for low drawdown and steady income around 1% per month.
income.read: This income-focused plan aims for steady monthly distributions around 1% with low drawdowns. It shifts away from growth and leverage towards income-generating assets, though NAV can still decline in market downturns.
